production.direction_en: At gray dawn, ash leaves whisper the names carved into them. Mahmut hears only wind; Fadyme hears one syllable spoken in her mother’s voice.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch1_ash_forest (calm layer) — rain, whispering leaves; one soft bell tone when Fadyme hears the syllable | post: sting_victory, then bgm_ch1_ash_forest

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: The last one ran when the bell stopped.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: It did not stop. It only learned to whisper.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: One step. Then another. The road does not need to know how many it costs.
